label: Strong version of the owner's 'exists out of time': at the selected world…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: Strong version of 'exists out of time' (#1017): composing UNIVERSE-CAUSE-OUTSIDE-SPACETIME with the open premise that every successive bearer of any supplied temporal series is a part of the spacetime whole, no cause of the whole is successively temporal in any supplied series (DISAMB-TEMPORAL-SENSE). The weak conclusion needs no claim about other times; the strong one needs exactly that premise, which a second series, or an aevum whose adjunct changes are recorded, with a successive bearer outside spacetime would falsify.
